items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Diana Krall and Glen Campbell and Michael Bolton, and Clint Eastwood and his wife and my band, and oh it was sensational.

ctx.x: Yeah you would get known as, you know, call this guy—

Yeah I was always a jazz player. And now everybody has to do everything. But to put a big band together, it’s always a thrill. We just got through working the AT&T Golf Tournament up there with Clint Eastwood, and we had a great show. Diana Krall and Glen Campbell and Michael Bolton, and Clint Eastwood and his wife and my band, and oh it was sensational.
Who writes most of your charts?
